$comment: INV-3. The only absolute URL prefixes allowed to appear anywhere in dist/. Everything else is a bug or an exfiltration path. Adding an entry here is a deliberate, reviewable act — see PLAN.md §4.
$comment-allowed: Endpoints the extension may contact. www.googleapis.com is the Drive API; accounts.google.com is the OAuth consent and revocation endpoints; oauth2.googleapis.com is the OAuth token endpoint, reached only by the PKCE fallback for profiles that are not signed into Chrome (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §13.2).
$comment-constants: URIs that are names rather than addresses: nothing dereferences them and no code path can. They are listed separately from `allowed` because widening that list means the extension may talk to one more host, and widening this one does not. The SVG namespace reaches dist/ from the vendored QR encoder's SVG builder, which is dead code we keep because the file is byte-identical to upstream and diffable against it (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §15).
